title: Trigger Bombs
description: This project adds custom explosions to Minecraft crafted by surrounding candles with tnt!
body:
- 16 Unique Variants: Every candle color has a distinct purpose and custom explosion logic.

- Custom Physics Engine: Specifically coded bombs (Black, Blue, Brown) tear blocks out of the world and turn them into physical entities.

- Anti-Grief Protection: Physics and explosions automatically ignore "illegal" blocks like Bedrock and Command Blocks, as well as NBT-heavy containers (Chests, Shulkers, etc.) to prevent item loss.

- Dynamic Detonation: Bombs explode on impact with entities/blocks, when dropped from the inventory, or automatically after 5 seconds in mid-air.

## Crafting
_**Works with all types of candles**_

![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/315bfbdf13531cc406c4239f1ad5b7f8a2c4bc08.png)

## config.yml
```
The cooldown in seconds between throwing bombs.
cooldown_seconds: 1.5
```

## Candle Explosions

⚪ White - Multi-color birthday particles.

🟠 Orange - Fire particles + breaks blocks.

🟣 Magenta - Gravity: Pulls entities toward it.

🧊 Light Blue - Ice particles + Freezes/Slows.

🟡 Yellow - Flashbang: Blinds anyone nearby.

🟢 Lime - Slime: Strong Slowness effect.

💗 Pink - Makes matching adult mobs breed.

🔘 Gray - Smoke + breaks blocks.

⚪ Light Gray - Ash: Blinds and damages targets.

💎 Cyan - Freezing burst + Damage.

🔮 Purple - Magic blast + breaks blocks.

🔵 Blue - Water blast + Physics (moves blocks).

🟤 Brown - Dirt blast + Physics (moves blocks).

🌲 Green - Toxic blast + Large block damage.

🔴 Red - Massive TNT explosion.

⚫ Black - Singularity: Huge blast + Physics (moves blocks).
